sourceOfTruth: The pack root containing SKILL.md, references/, scripts/ and assets/. Adapters are stubs that point at it, never copies of it.

policy.junctionGuard: Detect Windows reparse points before any stub write. Never write through a junction into the pack source.
policy.receipt: queen/reports/harness-install-<date>.md for any live install. This suite performs no live install and writes no global configuration.

pathStates.open: No discovery path could be sourced or measured. Recorded as [OPEN].
